The first term is $8$ and the common difference is $-13$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{-13\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-13\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{-13\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$8,$ | | $-5,$ | | $-18,$ | | $-31,...$

This is the recursive formula of $8, -5, -18, -31,...$

$\begin{cases}
d(1)=8
\\\\
d(n)=d(n-1)+(-13)
\end{cases}$
